tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Upload all necessary documents in technical criteria Documents required as per KC-4 Booklet without fail. if not upload necessary documents it will be rejected
The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders.
The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPPPortal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
The bidder should furnish the details in the formats attached with bid document (KC-4) and upload the same in the KPP-Portal
The bidder should upload required documents as per terms & conditions of RFP KC-4 uploaded in the KPP-Portal

The Consultant shall express the price of their services in Indian Rupees. The Bidder provide services as per the Terms of Reference of this RFP (KC-4 their total Consultancy Fees to prove The price quoted shall be exclusive GST.

The turnover certificate shall have UDIN generated through ICAI Portal. Turn over certificate without UDIN shall not be considered and treated as invalid & also upload the last five years profit & loss statement

To qualify for award of this contract, the Consultant in its name should submit last five years i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 Turnover and Profit and loss statement with UDIN Number
The Work Done Certificate shall have invariably bearing Work Indent Number issued by the Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer

Shall have minimum 5 years of experience in consultancy services (Credentials obtained from the client not below the rank of Executive Engineer shall shall be furnished indicating the work done and the consultancy for obtained for such projects.)
Shall not have been Black listed or Terminated in any of their Previous Projects
Shall not have any Litigation History in any of their Previous Projects
Period of completion of project is 90Days
Approxiate Length for which DPR has to be prepared by the bidder company/firm is 34.00Km

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder company/Firm The firm must have completed preparation of Detailed Project Report for at least one (1) Major Highway works-Single Road (Expressway/Dedicated Freight Corridor/Industrial Corridor / NH /SH only and minimum 4/6 lane)) in the last 5 years with a project cost of minimum INR 120.00 crores for each project / works.The Client for the project / works may be Central Government / State Government or a Public Sector Undertaking entity. Assignments for private sector entity shall not be eligible for these criteria. Kindly refer to the notes of Data Sheet in RFP for details of projects eligible for (1) Major Highway works-Single Road (Expressway/Dedicated Freight Corridor/Industrial Corridor / NH /SH only and minimum 4/6 lane) one such eligible project / works ((a)Cumulative length not less than 68 kms in the last five years (b)(One project of Length not less than 34 Km (minimum of 4/6 lane) in any one year in the last five years)
